mentions.name: Tyrese Haliburton
mentions.analysis: Haliburton's shooting numbers continue to be terrible, and he might be bothered by injuries. His shooting will improve, but the extent is uncertain.

mentions.name: Bennedict Mathurin
mentions.analysis: Mathurin is getting rebounds and has done enough to stick in the starting lineup at 30 minutes a night, making him a 12-team league guy.

mentions.name: Franz Wagner
mentions.analysis: Wagner is a sell-high candidate due to his current usage, which is unlikely to maintain when Paolo Banchero returns.

mentions.name: Anthony Black
mentions.analysis: Black's performance with four rebounds, six assists, four steals, and one block in 25 minutes is useful, especially against teams with bad defense like the Pacers.

mentions.name: Jonathan Isaac
mentions.analysis: If Isaac plays 22+ minutes a night, he can be a 12-team league player for categories. His recent performance with 11 rebounds, three blocks, eight points, and two threes is promising.

mentions.name: Javonte Green
mentions.analysis: Green played 26 minutes for two points and shot 10%. He is not producing efficiently or getting defensive stats.

mentions.name: Trey Murphy III
mentions.analysis: Murphy's shooting was off, but he should not be dropped. If someone drops him, he should be picked up immediately.

mentions.name: Cason Wallace
mentions.analysis: Wallace had five steals, which is why he would be streamed in. However, no long-term grab is necessary as Chet Holmgren was out.

mentions.name: Luguentz Dort
mentions.analysis: Dort played 32 minutes with 11 points, three threes, two steals, and a block, making him a player to roster.

mentions.name: Jared McCain
mentions.analysis: McCain had a great game with 34 points, six threes, 10 assists, and two steals. However, this performance came with several key players out, so expectations should be managed.

mentions.name: Caleb Martin
mentions.analysis: Martin had 18 points and seven rebounds with two steals. His steal numbers have been high recently, which is useful.

mentions.name: Reggie Jackson
mentions.analysis: Jackson had a good game with 34 points and four assists, but this is not expected to continue, and he can be ignored.

mentions.name: Kelly Oubre Jr.
mentions.analysis: Oubre had 20 points but zero assists. He is not worth rostering in 12-team leagues.

mentions.name: Ziaire Williams
mentions.analysis: Williams started and had 23 points and six rebounds with a steal and a block. He has had two big games in two starts.

mentions.name: Cam Thomas
mentions.analysis: Thomas is not taking as many shots as expected, making him less valuable for fantasy.

mentions.name: Jaden Ivey
mentions.analysis: Ivey was out, and his absence allowed other players to step up. His return could impact rotations.

mentions.name: Malik Beasley
mentions.analysis: Beasley played 44 minutes with 26 points and 10 rebounds. While Hardaway is out, he is a points and threes option.

mentions.name: Jabari Smith Jr.
mentions.analysis: Smith played 21 minutes with five points and four rebounds. He is not performing well and should be dropped.

mentions.name: Amen Thompson
mentions.analysis: Thompson played 34 minutes with 18 points, 11 rebounds, and three assists. He is a must-roster player with high potential.

mentions.name: Tari Eason
mentions.analysis: Eason played 26 minutes with 18 points, 10 rebounds, and two blocks. He is a must-roster player with high potential.

mentions.name: Jordan Poole
mentions.analysis: Poole had a great game with 42 points and six assists. His performance aligns with expectations for a high-usage player on a bad team.

mentions.name: Keldon Johnson
mentions.analysis: Johnson played 23 minutes with eight points and six rebounds. He is not performing well and should be dropped in 10- or 12-team leagues.

mentions.name: Donovan Clingan
mentions.analysis: Clingan played 31 minutes with 17 points, 12 rebounds, and eight blocks. He is a must-roster player with high potential, especially with other centers out.

mentions.name: Shaedon Sharpe
mentions.analysis: Sharpe had 33 points and needs high usage to be effective. His performance is dependent on the absence of other key players.

mentions.name: Deni Avdija
mentions.analysis: Avdija played 18 minutes with seven points and six rebounds. He is not performing well and should be dropped.

mentions.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
mentions.analysis: Pippen started and had 15 points, three rebounds, and three steals. His role may change with the return of other players.

mentions.name: D'Angelo Russell
mentions.analysis: Russell played 20 minutes with eight points and two assists. His performance is not meeting expectations, but dropping him may be premature.

mentions.name: Dillon Brooks
mentions.analysis: Brooks had 15 points with four threes. He is a streaming option for points and threes.

mentions.name: Jusuf Nurkic
mentions.analysis: Nurkic played 22 minutes with three points and 11 rebounds. Despite a poor shooting night, he should be held onto.

mentions.name: Joshua Okogie
mentions.analysis: Okogie had 25 points and eight rebounds, but this performance is not expected to continue, especially with key players returning.

mentions.name: Royce O'Neale
mentions.analysis: O'Neale had five points and four rebounds. His shooting has been poor, but his role remains consistent.
